reviewDecision.methodology: EVALUATE_RETURNED_EVIDENCE_NOT_RECREATE_IMPLEMENTATION. Consumed worker final logs (20 focused tests, example CLI, final 70/70 gate, six frozen hashes); all nine declared source pins match actual bytes before closure. Audited the locked profile against the complete bounded helper/test/guide/example and return, using named sources only. Root source-derived actual CLI/API oracles are separate from worker tests. Initial 63 probes exposed seven failures; two further source-derived positive boundary/pointer cases justified expanding the oracle to 65 (56 passed, nine failed). All known dependency classes were audited before one consolidated Local semantic repair. Reran focused tests and independent probes only for changed code/fixture bytes and named contradictions; accepted-byte fast gate preceded adding Local closure paths.
reviewDecision.findings: ACCEPT_BOUNDED after five attributed Local repair groups: (1) malformed requested identity and unhashable evidence/cap joins must preserve controlled field/sibling diagnostics; (2) nested requested-role and skipped-learning-index JSON pointers must locate original fields; (3) known budget owner failure may HOLD without numeric overrun, and a correctly constrained overrun is a valid held record; (4) reject the arbitrary date/time separator accepted by Python fromisoformat; (5) correct S3 reported Claude Haiku configuration and preserve S4 ACTION_VERIFIED/PARTIAL consumption in the derived example, separate from current S2 use of S4. Final 24/24 focused tests and 65/65 different-actor CLI/API probes passed. Amended-byte gate passed 70/70, COMPLIANT 6.11s. Original worker assertions, initial defects and two worker packet self-repairs remain historical evidence; they are not final acceptance of amended bytes.
reviewDecision.risk: Only optional offline declared consistency is accepted. Refs are never followed by the helper; Local source pin checks do not authenticate identity, authority, current source status or bills. Example is a retrospective projection, not a replacement S4 decision or original dispatch freeze. Helper 707 lines exceeds 600 advisory and stays below 900 hard limit: keep this bounded cross-field validator in one authorized module; no new split topology or guard exemption. Size enforcement PASS. Full outcome, score, PLL, Gateway, persistent store and hook/runtime integration remain deferred. Native requested Luna/xhigh remains separate from unknown observed identity/effort/harness and underlying provider usage; no model ranking or savings claim.
reviewDecision.closureDiagnostic: Local accepted-byte gate first failed solely on RESOLUTION_EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH: the active SCEC payload still pinned submitted test bytes. Updated that active pin to the amended regression file and reran once with information gain final-byte consistency: PASS 70/70. Original return/hash and failed log retained. This is Local closure packaging, separate from the single semantic repair. Root ignored-helper preparation also had one nested-quote SyntaxError before file writes (corrected using apply_patch), and one read-only rg guessed the S3 Local evidence date wrong (corrected to 2026-10-11). No deletion, provider call or worker attribution. Material and continuity gates/commits are required next and are not predeclared complete here. Material validation additionally detected PREDECESSOR_HASH_MISMATCH after closed-order metadata changed. The tranche helper suppressed detailed stdout; one named diagnostic rerun exposed the sole SCEC failure. Updated active predecessor to closed-order bytes; frozen rationale/profile/code unchanged. Retained both logs; no historical dispatch pin rewrite.
